visual.description: Warm off-white cream used as the main page background throughout the site.
Warm greige/taupe used as the navigation bar background in the top-of-page state.
White background that the navigation bar transitions to after scrolling.
Black text used for navigation links in the scrolled/opaque nav state.
Black used for primary navigation category links.
Black text for navigation links after scroll, consistent with top state.
Near-black used for body copy and paragraph text throughout the page.
Pure black used for section headings and editorial titles.
Medium grey used for secondary UI labels and utility link text such as Contact us.
Black used for button borders and thin divider lines in the UI.
Black underlined text used for standalone CTA links.
Deep near-black that dominates the hero video section and atmospheric editorial imagery.
Deep navy/indigo blue — a recurring atmospheric brand color.
